tasks.label: Run Current Java File
tasks.command: chcp 65001; Get-ChildItem -Path "${fileDirname}" -Filter *.class -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Remove-Item -Force; $javaFiles = Get-ChildItem -Path "${fileDirname}" -Filter *.java | ForEach-Object { $_.FullName }; & 'C:\Program Files\Eclipse Adoptium\jdk-17.0.19.10-hotspot\bin\javac.exe' -encoding UTF-8 -cp "${fileDirname}" -d "${fileDirname}" $javaFiles; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { & 'C:\Program Files\Eclipse Adoptium\jdk-17.0.19.10-hotspot\bin\java.exe' '-Dfile.encoding=UTF-8' -cp "${fileDirname}" "${fileBasenameNoExtension}" }

tasks.label: Compile Current Java File
tasks.command: chcp 65001; Get-ChildItem -Path "${fileDirname}" -Filter *.class -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Remove-Item -Force; $javaFiles = Get-ChildItem -Path "${fileDirname}" -Filter *.java | ForEach-Object { $_.FullName }; & 'C:\Program Files\Eclipse Adoptium\jdk-17.0.19.10-hotspot\bin\javac.exe' -encoding UTF-8 -cp "${fileDirname}" -d "${fileDirname}" $javaFiles
